title: No Bake Frozen Root Beer Float Pie
description: An easy, delicious, no-bake pie that captures the classic flavor of a root beer float in a frozen dessert.

ingredients.item: Whipped cream and maraschino cherries for garnish

steps: In a mixing bowl, combine the instant vanilla pudding, root beer, whole milk, and root beer extract.
Whisk the mixture for a couple of minutes until it starts to thicken.
Let the mixture rest for a minute.
Gently fold the tub of whipped topping into the pudding mixture.
Pour the mixture into the graham cracker pie crust and spread it out evenly.
Cover the pie with the plastic lid and place it in the freezer for at least half a day or overnight.
When ready to serve, decorate with whipped cream and maraschino cherries.
notes:
This is a favorite among no-bake pies. If you like root beer floats, you have to try this.
